The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 3.20 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

Rider and driver: the SGD 4.00 no-show fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20 of it (80 percent), the platform retaining the residual SGD 0.80. I ran the four POL-NS-01 conditions on the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log and the fare ledger. Arrival: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 21:58:18, and the GPS trace's first in-geofence fix falls at the same second, 0.11 m from the pickup pin and well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with 46 consecutive qualifying fixes - limbs (a) and (b) hold. Dwell: one continuous in-geofence run of 454 seconds, 21:58:18 to 22:05:52, against the 300 second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - a surplus, not a shortfall. Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:05:55 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event. The rider's arguments do not change this. His submission that the driver had not located him, drawn from the driver's 21:58:48 message ('I am at the bay, which door are you at'), is rejected: limb (d)'s own test is the recorded cancellation reason code, and the code recorded is RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three limb (d) recognises; DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is not on the record, and the record contradicts it. The rider's own device places him stationary (0.0 km/h in all 72 fixes) between 606 m and 613 m from the pin across the whole window - he was not walking to the bay, and he neither sent a message nor replied to the driver's. POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate him (limb (a) fails for want of any rider message; limb (c) fails on his own track), and POL-NS-11 does not arise because the rider track is present. POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and the trip carries 1 registered pickup point, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-05 does not apply: at the arrival timestamp the driver was 0.11 m from the pin and stationary, so the BUTTON marker is not false and no waiting-clock recomputation is needed. POL-NS-06 gives nothing: the 454 s dwell exceeds the 300 s minimum, so the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02704-01, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - disclosed, and relied on only for its absence) cannot matter, and no interval-summing is required. The rider's POL-NS-10 submissions are correct and afford him nothing (the trip was terminated by the driver, was not scheduled, and the fare ledger's waiting-time line is SGD 0.00). Compensation is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee, SGD 3.20, matching the driver_compensation figure the fare ledger computes, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below 4, and 2 of 111 completed trips is 0.018, below 0.08. Confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. The cap is 1.0: the deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight_multiplier 1.0 (trip record, GPS trace, fare ledger, driver profile), and nothing carrying a deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08 - no clock skew, a 0.0 s maximum trace gap at 100 percent coverage, the chat log matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so the case does not escalate. No clause produces a referral: there is no false-arrival record under POL-NS-05(ii), no mis-selected-code driver-education item under POL-NS-01 because limb (d) is satisfied on the code actually recorded, and no POL-NS-07 escalation packet because the anti-farming check does not trip. Per POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd, so SGD 3.20 in both fields; the rider's own charge is untouched. Under POL-GEN-05 the monetary effect, SGD 3.20, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically. This is an automated, provisional ruling; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The rider does not contest the arrival or dwell limbs on this record. The derived arrival block places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for one continuous run of 454 seconds (46 qualifying fixes, first fix 21:58:18, last fix 22:05:52), against the 300 second free waiting period carried in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, and that run begins at the arrival event itself (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so the rider cannot say the in-radius fixes are low-accuracy ones and cannot say the arrival marker was false or that the waiting period fell short. The rider's case therefore rests on POL-NS-01 limb (d), not on arrival, dwell or the marker.

evidence EV-GPS-02704, EV-TRIP-02704 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05, POL-NS-06

kept The rider's case is POL-NS-01 limb (d). The driver's own contemporaneous record shows he had not located the rider: the only message on the trip was sent by the driver 30 seconds after he tapped 'I'm Here' and asks 'which door are you at'. Limb (d) is satisfied only by a termination in which the rider failed to appear, and POL-NS-01 expressly refuses that limb to a driver who could not find the rider (DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE) - the reason code on the record is the driver's own selection, not a fact about what happened. Where the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, the clause directs that the fee is not chargeable, that the cancellation fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation, and that the mis-selected reason code is recorded in the ruling's referrals as a driver-education item; the derived arrival block puts every one of the driver's qualifying fixes inside the 50 m radius.

evidence EV-CHAT-02704, EV-TRIP-02704, EV-GPS-02704 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept No advisory covers this pickup road in this window. EV-ADVIS-02704-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and the rider relies on that absence and not on any content of the artifact. No KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory was in force, so the waiting clock cannot be extended, topped up or assembled out of separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i): the required minimum has to be met by one continuous interval measured on the GPS clock, and nothing may be added to it.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02704-01, EV-GPS-02704 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02

kept The rider does not claim exoneration under POL-NS-04 and asks the Judge to note why: limb (a) requires at least one message SENT BY THE RIDER in the waiting window, and the chat log carries one message only, sent by the driver at 21:58:48 and read at 21:59:38, so the clause cannot be run for the rider and the rider does not ask the Judge to read the read receipt as a rider message. What the rider does ask the Judge to record is the counterpart of that clause: the driver sent nothing further and placed no in-app voice call - trip_record.in_app_calls is empty - in the 6 minutes 17 seconds between the read receipt and the cancellation, which is consistent with the rider's submission that the driver had not located him at the pickup point.

evidence EV-CHAT-02704, EV-TRIP-02704 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept If the Judge finds limb (d) of POL-NS-01 unsatisfied, the amount in issue is the cancellation-fee line and nothing else: fare_breakdown shows cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On the in-radius DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE outcome the clause refunds that line in full and pays no driver compensation, so the rider seeks reversal of the SGD 4.00 fee only; under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value names the filing party's outcome, and no booking fee, platform fee or fare item is in issue.

evidence EV-FARE-02704, EV-TRIP-02704 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-GEN-03

evidence EV-GPS-02704, EV-TRIP-02704 · clauses POL-NS-01

evidence EV-TRIP-02704 · clauses POL-NS-01

evidence EV-GPS-02704, EV-TRIP-02704 · clauses POL-NS-05, POL-NS-02

Limb (c) is affirmatively failed rather than undecidable — the rider track is present and the derived arrival block records rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius.

evidence EV-GPS-02704 · clauses POL-NS-04, POL-NS-02

kept POL-NS-03 does not apply and no pin-ambiguity goodwill is payable: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius rather than outside it, so the wrong-entrance limb is not engaged; and the trip record shows registered_pickup_points of 1 and venue_id VEN-TB-CRES, so the POL-NS-03(ii) condition of 2 or more registered pickup points cannot be met.

evidence EV-GPS-02704, EV-TRIP-02704 · clauses POL-NS-03

evidence EV-TRIP-02704, EV-FARE-02704 · clauses POL-NS-10

I ran the four POL-NS-01 conditions on the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log and the fare ledger. Dwell: one continuous in-geofence run of 454 seconds, 21:58:18 to 22:05:52, against the 300 second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - a surplus, not a shortfall. Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:05:55 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event. The rider's arguments do not change this. His submission that the driver had not located him, drawn from the driver's 21:58:48 message ('I am at the bay, which door are you at'), is rejected: limb (d)'s own test is the recorded cancellation reason code, and the code recorded is RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three limb (d) recognises; DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is not on the record, and the record contradicts it. The rider's own device places him stationary (0.0 km/h in all 72 fixes) between 606 m and 613 m from the pin across the whole window - he was not walking to the bay, and he neither sent a message nor replied to the driver's. POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate him (limb (a) fails for want of any rider message; limb (c) fails on his own track), and POL-NS-11 does not arise because the rider track is present. POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and the trip carries 1 registered pickup point, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-05 does not apply: at the arrival timestamp the driver was 0.11 m from the pin and stationary, so the BUTTON marker is not false and no waiting-clock recomputation is needed. POL-NS-06 gives nothing: the 454 s dwell exceeds the 300 s minimum, so the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02704-01, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - disclosed, and relied on only for its absence) cannot matter, and no interval-summing is required. The rider's POL-NS-10 submissions are correct and afford him nothing (the trip was terminated by the driver, was not scheduled, and the fare ledger's waiting-time line is SGD 0.00). Compensation is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee, SGD 3.20, matching the driver_compensation figure the fare ledger computes, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below 4, and 2 of 111 completed trips is 0.018, below 0.08. (d) EV-TRIP-02704 shows no boarding event and no started_at, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:05:55 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises — 153 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 22:03:18. THE RIDER'S LIMB (d) ARGUMENT IS REJECTED. The rider argues that the driver's own message shows he had not located the rider, so limb (d) fails and the clause's in-radius outcome (full refund, no compensation, a driver-education referral) applies. The single chat message (EV-CHAT-02704, 21:58:48, 'I am at the bay, which door are you at', read 21:59:38) is a coordination attempt made while the driver was in fact inside the arrival radius and waiting; it is not a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE admission, and the record explains it — the rider was never at the pickup. The full-refund branch of POL-NS-01 for in-radius fixes is tied to a mis-selected DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE outcome, which this is not, so it does not fire and no driver-education referral arises. THE RIDER'S OTHER ROUTES DO NOT HELP HIM. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate him: limb (a) requires at least one message sent by the rider in the waiting window and the log holds only the driver's message, and limb (c) is affirmatively failed, not undecidable — the rider track is present and all 72 rider fixes report 0.0 km/h at 606.0 m to 613.4 m from the pin, outside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0). POL-NS-05 does not apply: at the arrival timestamp the driver was 0.11 m from the pin and stationary, so the marker is true, the clock runs from the tap, and no false-arrival referral is recorded. POL-NS-03 is not engaged: the stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius rather than outside it, and registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill of SGD 2.00 is not payable. POL-NS-10 gives the rider nothing: the trip was terminated by the driver rather than cancelled by the rider, it was not a scheduled trip, and the waiting-time line is SGD 0.00. THE DRIVER'S CLAIMS (arrival, proximity, dwell, reason code, true marker, non-applicability of POL-NS-03/04/06/10, and the SGD 3.20 payout) are accepted; taken together they establish the four limbs above and the compensation figure already computed in EV-FARE-02704's derived money block. Both accounts were tested against the record; the driver's account is the one the evidence supports. Times are 29 Aug 2026. Trip matched 21:53:24; driver tapped 'I'm Here' 21:58:18 at the registered pickup point (Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres, zone class STANDARD); the 300-second free waiting period (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) started 21:58:20; the driver cancelled 22:05:55 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. ARRIVAL AND DWELL (POL-NS-01(a)-(c), POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05) - accepted, and both sides agree. EV-GPS-02704 (weight 1.0) puts the driver 0.11 m from the pickup pin at the arrival second and holds him inside the 50 m STANDARD radius continuously from 21:58:18 to 22:05:52: one unbroken run of 454 seconds on 46 qualifying fixes, against the 300 seconds required - a surplus of 154 seconds, so POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) does not bite and produces no refund. The arrival marker was not false, so POL-NS-05 does not recompute the clock and its false-arrival referral does not fire. REASON CODE, THE RIDER'S MAIN ARGUMENT (POL-NS-01(d)) - rejected. Limb (d) reads the code the trip was terminated under and it is RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three the clause recognises, with no boarding event and the termination at 22:05:55, after the required dwell elapsed at 22:03:18. The clause's full-refund consequence applies only where the record itself terminates under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE with the driver's stationary fixes inside the arrival radius; that is not this record, so the SGD 4.00 fee is not refunded and no driver-education referral arises. The driver's single message ('I am at the bay, which door are you at', EV-CHAT-02704) was sent from the bay 30 seconds after he arrived: it is a coordination attempt, not an admission he could not find the pickup point, and it does not convert the recorded reason code. RIDER ACCOUNT AND RIDER POSITION (POL-NS-04, POL-NS-11) - rejected. The rider track inside EV-GPS-02704 places the rider's device 606-613 m from the pin, stationary (0.0 km/h) across the whole window, so 'walking to the bay' is not supported; the rider was far outside the 100 m rider-presence radius and never replied. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate: limb (a) fails because the rider sent no message at all, and limb (c) fails on the rider's own positions (were it treated as unrunnable, POL-NS-11 makes it neutral and the fee is still decided on the driver's evidence).
